critique: Unanimous, the same fail S1-R46 foresaw. Cast (Lançar) is now larger, but in the 960 px grayscale it is a dark plum plate with a cream word, the same value and treatment as Fugir (Get out) and the pause button, so it has no value step over them; the gold Batedor label and the gold borders are more saturated than the primary. The tall top-left loot panel (Espaço 508 / Restam / Cofre 0%), larger than Cast, with heavy white 508 and 0% numerals, and the 2:25 timer and Alarme 0/6 boxes beside it, still draw the eye first, so they act as second primaries (v3: larger and heavier). The pass anchor's light gold Level up clearly leads, so the candidate stays below the bar. Rendered at 85be2fa8 with FIT=1 TEXT=200 LOCALE=pt_BR via screen_heist.gd ('fit ok'). The fix: Cast must be the lightest, most saturated plate at 200% text, the gold plate (S1-R46, granted by the lead in cycle 187), and the loot panel's numerals and the timer and alarm figures must not be heavier or lighter than Cast's word.
